how_to_use_raw:
A few tips to help you color with total confidence:
Skin Allergy Test - Madison Reed always recommends you do a sensitivity test before coloring your hair. At least 48 hours beforehand, mix 1 part Radiant Cream Color (a small squeeze) with 1.5 parts Conditioning Color Activator (a few drops). Use a cotton swab to apply a quarter-sized amount to a small patch of skin behind your ear or inside your elbow. Keep dry. Wait 48 hours. If there is no sign of change to the area, then you're ready to color. Always consult your physician if you have questions or concerns. If you've had a sensitivity to hair color in the past, you may be more likely to have a reaction.
Please see the instructions included in your Radiant Hair Color kit for the best application to achieve your desired results.
Tips and tricks from the experts - Wear a shirt or smock that buttons or zips up the front to make cleanup easy. Begin with dry, unwashed hair. The day after your last shampoo is best for coloring. Make sure hair is free of styling products as they coat hair and may block the color.
Total Color Processing Time = 35 minutes (or 45 minutes for maximum gray coverage)
Precautions: Everyone is different, and all permanent hair color contains ingredients which can cause an allergic reaction, which in rare cases, can be severe. Therefore, you must follow the precautions listed on the included instructions.

how_to_use_raw:
Begin with dry hair. Comb and part your hair as you normally wear it. Put on gloves.
Open one activator packet and pour it into the bowl.
Mix the color and activator with the brush until fully blended.
Apply to your roots on your t-zone (hairline & part).
Use the cleansing wipe to remove any color from your skin.
Set a timer for 10 minutes.
Wearing gloves, rinse hair until the water runs clear.
Shampoo then condition with the Color Therapy Hair Mask included in your kit.
Let the mask sit for 5 minutes then rinse again.
Precautions: Everyone is different, and all permanent hair color contains ingredients which can cause an allergic reaction, which in rare cases, can be severe. Therefore, you must follow the precautions listed on the included instructions.

how_to_use_raw:
Because everyone's hair is different, do the strand test and see the result of the color before full application. A patch test is also recommended to confirm you're not allergic.
Step 1: Shampoo and dry hair thoroughly. Do NOT use conditioner.
Step 2: Use coconut oil (or petroleum jelly) around hairline and on ears to prevent staining of the skin (optional).
Step 3: Remove bottle cap and inner seal.
Step 4: Wear protective gloves for application and pour desired amount into bowl.
Step 5: Apply color evenly with color brush. Begin at the root of the hair and work it evenly through to the ends. Start nape of the neck and work upwards through the head and be sure to completely saturate the hair shaft.
Step 6: Place a plastic cap over the hair and leave color on for at least 1/2 hour or more. Arctic Fox hair color will NOT damage your hair and has added conditioner, so leaving it on for longer will not hurt a thing.
Step 7: Rinse hair in tepid water thoroughly, until the water runs clear. For the first rinse, do not rinse hair while showering! Best bet is to rinse in the kitchen sink with cold water.
To prevent color bleeding make sure hair is completely dry before sleeping.

how_to_use_raw:
On day one, apply to damp hair, rake through, and style. On day two (and so on), apply to dry hair to refresh and restyle.
PRO TIPS
Mist from mid-lengths to ends, working through your hair by squeezing it in. Air-dry for natural styles or blow-dry with a round or flat brush for smooth, straight styles.
Some areas of the hair may be more (or less) porous than others. Take some time massaging into hair after spraying to help absorb evenly.
When detangling, try using a wide tooth comb. It's a great way to help prevent breakage.

description_raw:
Benefits
Cleanses, tones, and refreshes hair & scalp with a custom targeted nozzle
Instantly dissolves hard buildup & dead skin without disturbing your style
Gentle cooling effect offers instant relief from style-related itchiness or tension
Helps calm and soothe the scalp
A go-to spray for maintaining protective styles and extensions on the daily, or whenever you need an instant clean
For those seeking relief in hard-to-reach places: extensions, weaves, cornrows, wigs, etc.
For those in protective styles looking to cleanse the scalp or shampoo less frequently
For those seeking soothing relief & a refresh from style-related itchiness or tension on the scalp
Safe for your natural hair, human hair wigs, human hair extensions, human hair weaves, human hair braiding hair, synthetic braiding hair

how_to_use_raw:
Step 0:
* Drape a towel around your shoulders or put on a t-shirt you don't mind getting stained.
* Grab a wide tooth comb, a few hair clips, a timer and a cotton cloth.
* Divide your hair into four quadrants, by center parting hair from front to back, then from ear to ear. Clip each section onto head.
Step 1:
* Apply PROTECT 1 COLOR BLOCK BARRIER GEL directly to the skin along your hairline and ears to avoid staining.
Step 2:
* Squeeze the entire tube of COLOR 2 RICH CREAM PIGMENT into the ACTIVATE 3 NOURISHING COLOR DEVELOPER bottle (every drop counts!).
Step 3:
* Time to activate. Shake the bottle vigorously until the pigment and developer are fully combined.
a.) Put on the gloves and work one quadrant at a time starting from the back, and applying color in small sections using the tip applicator. Be sure to saturate your hair from roots to ends, and massage through to ensure even application.
b.) Once you finish the back, repeat the steps, starting from the crown and working towards the hairline, saving the finer hairs in front for last.
c.) After all your hair is coated with color, massage color into your scalp so you don't miss a strand.
d.) Clip your hair away from your face and neck, then let it process for 35 minutes. For stubborn grays, leave on for 45 minutes.
Step 4:
* Fully rinse color until water runs clear and cleanse with your favorite IGK shampoo. After cleansing, squeeze out excess water from the hair. Apply TREAT 4 POST-COLOR TREATMENT MASK generously to hair from roots to ends, combing through with a wide tooth comb. Leave on for 5 minutes. Rinse thoroughly.
Step 5:
* Saturate a cotton cloth with the ERASE 5 STAIN-REMOVING CLEANSER, then gently dab and wipe any stained areas of the skin or work surface.

how_to_use_raw:
Step 1: To create the best blank canvas for your color, we recommend that you first lighten your hair with our easy-to-use GDY Lightening Kit. This is because our semi- permanent dye shows up best on level 9 or 10 light blonde hair. You can use DYEposit in Platinum to pre-tone the hair to remove any yellow tones.
Step 2: Squeeze your color into the GDY Biodegradable Tool Kit. Remember: wear gloves to prevent staining on your hands.
Step 3: Do a strand test on a piece of hair in the lower back portion of your head before applying the color all over your hair to ensure you love the look!
Step 4: Divide your hair into 4 equal sections and apply dye directly onto dry hair. Make sure the color is fully saturated throughout each section by applying a dollop of color for every two inch portion of your hair. Gently emulsify/massage into the hair to ensure coverage.
Step 5: Let the color sit on your hair for at least 30 minutes.
Step 6: Rinse very well with cool water only. If desired, use Color Kind Wash and Rinse to remove any residual dye. Shampoo and conditioner are not required, however.
Step 7: Style your freshly dyed locks just the way you like.

how_to_use_raw:
Shake well & dispense 1-2 pumps into hand (a little goes a long way). Rake through damp hair & scrunch. Follow with Rizos Curls Light Hold Gel for added hold. Air dry or diffuse. Once dry, lock-in your style with a light mist of Rizos Curls Alcohol-Free Hair Spray.
How to Pair with Rizos Curls Award-Winning Stylers:
**For More Moisture:**Apply Rizos Curls Refresh & Detangle Spray as a leave-in conditioner before applying the Curl Defining Mousse.
**For More Hold:**Apply Rizos Curls Light Hold Gel after applying the Curl Defining Mousse.
For More Volume:
Apply Rizos Curls Beach Waves Texturizing Salt Spray to roots & hair as the last step to your styling routine. Follow by drying hair with the Rizos Curls Collapsible Diffuser.
Pre-caution: Avoid contact with eyes. If product gets into eye rinse thoroughly with water. For external use only.

how_to_use_raw:
Wearing suitable gloves, apply to wet hair, lather and rinse well. Repeat if necessary. For maximum benefits, leave second lather on 3-5 minutes. Follow with Total Results. So Silver Conditioner. To maximize toning results use Total Results So Silver Triple Power Hair Mask 1-2x per week in lieu of the Conditioner.
Precautions: This product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation on certain individuals and a preliminary test according to accompanying directions should first be made. This product must not be used for dyeing the eyelashes or eyebrows; to do so may cause blindness. Avoid contact with the eyes and skin (other than areas of application). If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Keep out of reach of children. Do not ingest. Wear disposable gloves when applying. Wash hands thoroughly after use. Do not use on sensitive or irritated scalps. Perform the following skin allergy test 48 hours before each use of this product, as allergies can develop suddenly, even though you have previously used a haircolor product from this brand or another. Skin allergy test: with soap and water, wash an area the size of a quarter in the bend of your/your client's elbow. Pat dry with absorbent cotton. Apply product to test area, using an absorbent cotton-tipped applicator. Let test spot dry. You should not wash, cover or disturb for 48 hours. You should examine test area periodically over the next 48 hours. If you or your client experiences any reactions - such as redness, burning, itching, swelling skin abrasions, eruptions or irritation in or around the test area, you should not use this product or any other haircolor until after consulting a doctor.

how_to_use_raw:
Step 1: Mix the color and activator
Step 2: Apply color all over from roots to ends
Step 3: Process for 20 minutes
Step 4: Shampoo, condition, rinse
Be sure to read and follow the ColorWonder instructions included in your kit carefully before use.
A Few Pro Tips Before You Color: Your hair doesn't need to be squeaky-clean, but it should definitely be free of heavy styling products. (They can coat the hair and block the color from working to its maximum.) Hair color and activator should be at room temperature before mixing. Love your linens? Feel free to use a darker towel and pillowcase after the first couple of washes to keep them protected from any color transfer. If your hair is chemically straightened, relaxed, or permed, we recommend waiting two weeks to color after your last chemical treatment.

how_to_use_raw:
Things to Remember: Must follow exact instructions for best results. Requires heat to activate. Must be applied on damp hair. Must blow-dry and apply section by section. To create a sleek finish, the tighter the hair texture, the more tension is required.
Start with clean, damp, detangled hair and part into 4 sections.
On one section only, apply 2 pumps or a quarter-size amount, working from roots to ends. Comb through to coat evenly.
Blow-dry that section immediately with tension until fully dry. Apply to the next section and repeat process. If a section becomes dry before blow-drying, mist with water to rewet.
Tension Tip: As you blow-dry, stretch the hair while using a comb/brush attachment or a round brush.
Once all sections are dry, finish with flat iron to seal style. Ensure hair is fully blow-dried, not wet, before flat-ironing or pressing.
Tension Tip: Use the "chase method", chasing the flat iron with the Parting Tail Comb.
Reminder: Frequent exposure to high temperatures may loosen your natural curl pattern.

how_to_use_raw:
After shampooing and conditioning, apply a generous amount to damp hair. For best results, rake hands through hair to increase separation. Let air dry. For extra bounce, diffuse.
Caution: Use product only as directed. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately with water. For external use only.

product_name: All Soft Moisture Restore Leave-In Treatment with Hyaluronic Acid
description_raw:
Benefits
Immediate moisturization & hydration
Heat protection up to 450°F/230°C*
Hair feels moisturized up to 72 hours**
Instantly conditions for 10x smoother hair*
Visually sleekens split ends, tames frizz, and detangles hair** *vs. non-conditioning shampoo **based on consumer testing results
Key Ingredients
Formulated with the humectant of Hyaluronic Acid, which retains water to provide immediate hydration to hair.
With fatty alcohols that deposit onto the hair fiber to leave hair conditioned and moisturized without weighing it down.
